==Description==
'''Big Gubby Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 38 on the regular track. It had a cost of {{Bunz|1,360}} or {{Robux|151}}. The total cost was {{Bunz|24,220}} or {{Robux|4,021}}.

==Appearance==
'''Big Gubby Charm''' showcases an large bunny standing on a pot, breaking it as a result. It plays the sound of a fat bunny landing.

The color of the '''Big Gubby Charm''' depends on the color of the player's name in chat, but it is purple in its preview in the inventory.

==Trivia==
*'''Big Gubby Charm''' references the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/gubby-roblox Gubby] meme.
